text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant, pant*...
The gap between me and my "friend"...
has narrowed... a little...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Still, she couldn't catch up...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: And... Special Week-san was even more... than expected.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa, whew~!
I ran that with everything I had—!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
This is the power of Hokkaido's bounty, Cafe-san!
You get stronger for every bite you eat and every mile you run!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: So this is... Special Week's...

It seemed something lingered
in Manhattan Cafe's heart.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, next up...
About our next objective...

—I think. Going by conventional wisdom,
advancing to the spring Grand Prix, the Takarazuka Kinen, is the standard path.

Still, that sickly expression is plain to see. And the condition
of her hooves is concerning. Taking a "rest" might also...

...I feel a silent pressure. It's as if
they're saying, taking a break is "UNACCEPTABLE"...

...If that's the case, let's stick to the standard theory here.
And give her a rest during the summer—
With that policy decided,
choice_data_list: Let's go with the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: —No.

For an instant, I doubted my ears.
Opposing Manhattan Cafe...
That voice... sounded like it belonged to someone else...

Even if she says "no," there shouldn't be
a better spring option than the Takarazuka Kinen.
Where on earth is she going, then?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
At this rate... I won't reach it...
To become stronger, faster...
The path we must take is...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Over there...
A ghost-like movement. It was slow and deliberate, yet the direction she pointed was unmistakably clear.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Overseas...
Across the ocean, to "France"...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
My "friend" is going away...
All alone... That's why, I definitely...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heh, heheh, overseas... huh.
I see...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
An imaginary friend has no physical form.
So the laws of physics simply don't apply, huh?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, maybe I should attempt communication.
Hello, this is a three-dimensional being speaking.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Do you intend to destroy the parent body?
Or do you place your faith in it?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...Words do not reach them.
Or perhaps they simply do not wish to communicate.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...
Will you grant my wish?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
My "friend" is also saying, "Come here."
So...

An expedition to France... That is indeed
an even greater option than the Takarazuka Kinen.

To conquer "that race" in France.
It is the ultimate dream of everyone involved in Umamusume racing.

Considering Manhattan Cafe's current physical condition...
It's certainly tough. But if she herself dreams of it.
And above all else—

"Chasing after my friend."
Because that—is a precious promise between the two of us.

Upon hearing that,
Manhattan Cafe smiled, while Agnes Tachyon gave a slight shrug.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's right. I forgot to mention.
Just between you and me, I actually
don't like airplanes!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I won't ask you... to follow me.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"Still, we must go.
After all... that is why we made our contract..."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...Well, this is just between us,
so don't worry about it. Still though—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Being crazy...
was supposed to be my exclusive trademark.
"And so, our plan was set. However, mindful of the potential toll on Manhattan Cafe after the Tenno Sho (Spring)—"

For now, I decide to keep the domestic goal of the "Takarazuka Kinen" as an option.
The final decision on the French expedition will be made next month.
